design.dependencies: Zod plus a type-only PlaybackPlan import; no application or infrastructure imports.
design.failureBehavior: Studio HTTP 200 with malformed or invalid JSON becomes API_CONTRACT_MISMATCH/502; playback plan parsing returns null and consumers fail closed; multipart consumers stop before subsequent requests or PUTs.
design.compatibility: Existing endpoints and URLs are unchanged; response schemas accept additive DTO fields.

limits: Playback and authenticated Studio pipeline were verified through a running local Next.js HTTP process and disposable PostgreSQL; multipart upload HTTP with real R2 was not exercised, so K21-T1 remains partial.
Focused tests cover the changed client boundary, not every response from the running server; K21-T2 remains partial.
No independent review; R21 is not marked closed.
